=== EMAIL to primary@example.com
Subject: XYZ789 is now on your permit “Visitor”
Provenance: You received this at primary@example.com because this address manages, or shares access to, a p.stonn account that schedules a visitor parking permit. p.stonn is a free, unofficial scheduler for City of Stonnington visitor parking permits.
Hero: XYZ789

Baba — XYZ789 is now on your permit “Visitor”. Someone in your household put it on with the quick picker. When the booking ends, your roster takes over, or if nothing is scheduled, the rego stays on until the next change.

This is simply to confirm the change, and you don’t need to do anything.

We have also told sam@example.com (by email) and baba@example.com (by email, as the driver of XYZ789).

https://p.stonn.org
